text:
jordan: Heads up — ACME reporting sustained 503s on hosted inference in us-west2, rising p95 and SDK clients doing heavy retries. customer ticket 32214. sample req id: req_0a1b2c3. Can someone triage?

sam: On it. any recent deploys? also need a log snippet & example curl to repro.

ops-bot: CI/CD deploy completed at 1723456600 by ci/cd:edge-deploy service=edge-proxy v=3.2.1

priya: fyi: pattern sounds similar to the keepalive exhaustion we saw last week. I'll check edge-proxy conn queue + node ephemeral ports. Jordan can you paste a repro cURL and the SDK log lines?

jordan: repro (sanitized):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "X-Request-ID: req_0a1b2c3" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
SDK log excerpt: `2024-05-12T15:23:10Z WARN Retrying request status=503 id=req_0a1b2c3 attempt=2`
HTTP response body: `\{"error":"gateway timeout","status":503,"code":"EDGE_CONN_RESET"\}`

sam: grep on edge-proxy logs for that req id returns many TLS teardown / connection reset lines. also seeing bursts of ephemeral port reuse on node-edge-07 (netstat shows many TIME_WAIT). Suspect upstream keepalive not being reused (clients opening new sockets) causing proxy to run out of ephemeral ports under burst.

sam: quick mitigation options: 1) enable upstream keepalive reuse on proxy config, 2) expand ip_local_port_range on node-edge-07, 3) short circuit clients to a fallback gateway. I can do 1) & 2) temporarily.

mike: I'd like to send a short status to ACME. Proposed: "we're investigating transient 503s affecting some requests in us-west2. we've applied a temporary mitigation and monitoring. next update in 2h or earlier if resolved." OK to send?

priya: I'm going to flip the keepalive_reuse flag and increase pool size on the edge-proxy deployment. Command: `helm upgrade edge-proxy --set proxy.keepalive.reuse=true --set proxy.ephemeralPoolSize=256 infra/edge`

ops-bot: Alert: 5xx-rate (us-west2) spiked to 4.8% at 1723456705, triggered paging.

priya: applied keepalive_reuse=true on canary pods at 1723456850. increasing ip_local_port_range on node-edge-07 to 1024-65535 applied at 1723456902.

ops-bot: Metric update: 5xx-rate (us-west2) decreased to 0.9% at 1723457000 after config changes.

jordan: Customer update sent: matched mike's text + ETA. ACME replied asking for root cause and whether billing for retried requests will be refunded.

sam: Root cause hypothesis: connection churn -> ephemeral port exhaustion -> proxy returning connection resets to upstream -> client perceives 503s and retries. Follow-ups: collect longer traces and quantify retry amplification. I'll open a postmortem and keep priya on the loop for oncall notes.

jordan: closing short-term incident. action items: sam to own postmortem, priya to add node epoch monitoring for port exhaustion, ops to review SDK default connection reuse docs. cc @sam @priya

mike: thanks team — i'll follow up with ACME on billing question and escalate to revenue ops if needed.

ops-bot: Incident closed (temporary mitigation stable) at 1723457120
